jobs.occupation: Generator Service Engineer (f/m/d) for Rotating Equipment (Servicetechniker/in - IT)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As a Generator Service Engineer (f/m/d) for Rotating Equipment, you provide expert technical support for generator operation and rotating equipment engineering across our global service business. You assess complex operational issues, investigate technical findings, and identify reliability risks to improve the performance and availability of the installed fleet. Working closely with global engineering and service teams, you develop technical solutions, support critical operational decisions, and drive continuous engineering improvements.How You’ll Make an Impact * Assess complex operational issues, technical findings, and reliability risks related to generators and rotating equipment* Provide engineering support to resolve critical technical challenges and improve the performance and availability of the installed fleet* Analyze generator telemetry, diagnostic data, and operational logs to identify anomalies and determine root causes* Develop technical recommendations and engineering solutions to mitigate operational risks and continuously improve engineering standards and service guidelines* Collaborate with global service operations, engineering teams, and customers to share technical expertise, conduct root cause analyses, and resolve complex generator issues* Prepare technical reports and risk assessments to support strategic decision-making and provide expert engineering advice to senior leadership and customersWhat You Bring* A university degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related technical field* Extensive experience in generator service engineering, commissioning, or operational support of rotating equipment* In-depth knowledge of generator design, operating principles, and rotating equipment, including vibration analysis, diagnostic techniques, and electrical testing* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience in root cause analysis, failure mode analysis, and technical risk assessment* Excellent communication and consulting skills, with the ability to interpret technical data, prepare engineering documentation, and collaborate effectively across global, cross-functional teams* Fluent English and professional proficiency in German, enabling effective communication in local and international operationsAbout the TeamOur Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

jobs.description: About HeraeusMaking displays foldable? Helping hearts beat with medical innovations? Or breathing new life into precious metals? jobs.description: In this role, you will drive the efficiency of the global Stage-Gate process for product development across LIXIL's brands and regions. You are the operational engine behind our R&D delivery: ensuring clear work packages, disciplined gate transitions, and practical governance that project teams can easily adopt. As the primary subject matter expert, you will serve as the trusted advisor for project managers and gatekeepers on all process inquiries.The role works through influence across a matrixed, multi-cultural organisation and is a service to colleagues rather than an audit function. R&D is in active transformation on tooling and data quality, so ambiguity and shifting priorities are part of the job.Your Responsibilities:- Drive continuous optimisation of the global Stage-Gate Work Packages, ensuring deliverables are lean, consistent and harmonised across brands and regions.- Maintain and enforce the global R&D governance framework: processes, tools, RASCI models, cadence structures and compliance checkpoints.- Safeguard gate readiness, documentation integrity and audit readiness across all gate transitions.- Define, track and report R&D KPIs covering gate discipline, cycle time and pipeline health.- Develop and maintain digitalized templates, blueprints, work instructions and process documentation that simplify execution for project managers.- Coordinate cross-functional and cross-regional alignment, so local delivery conforms to global R&D standards.- Ensure Stage-Gate documentation and gate data are captured consistently and kept current in the governing systems, and represent process requirements towards the system owners.- Build and maintain the R&D Knowledge Hub as the single, topic-structured source for process documentation, templates and training material, curated as an ongoing exercise.- Ensure data continuity between Stage-Gate governance and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), acting as the business-side representative to translate process requirements into system specifications with the Global PLM team.Your Profile:- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Business Management, Industrial Management or comparable.- 7 to 10 years in process management, R&D project management or operational excellence, gained across more than one industry, ideally in product development or manufacturing.- Proven implementation of Stage-Gate or comparable phase-gate models- Working understanding of project and portfolio management systems used in an R&D environment (e.g. Planisware Orchestra, SAP) and good data literacy for KPI definition and process analysis.- Interest in how AI, automation and digital tools can simplify product development processes.- Solid understanding of PLM, ERP, and engineering change management systems (e.g., SAP, Planisware Orchestra), with the ability to align process governance with system architecture.- Demonstrated comfort, curiosity and respect across cultures and working styles is a core requirement.- Gives and receives feedback constructively.- Lean, Six Sigma or comparable optimisation approaches an advantage.- Strong moderation and stakeholder skills, able to steer cross-regional teams without direct reporting lines. Able to translate between technical detail and business framing.- Business-fluent English required, German an advantage.Our offer:- A salary package that ties directly to your work experience and responsibilities- Comprehensive health management, including an on-site fitness room, local and digital health services, Health Cashback, and Hansefit membership- Diversity & Inclusion: We offer equal opportunities for all individuals and support your personal development- Access to a wide range of employee benefits, such as discounts on travel, fashion, media, mobile phones, and more- A highly motivated, appreciative, and international team that inspires you and offers opportunities to learn and grow- A modern company restaurant to ensure your well-being during the dayInterested?Then we are looking forward to your application!
